mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in monthly employment growth below -50,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer and business confidence and lowering earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,000 units indicates growing consumer demand, which raises earnings expectations and corporate valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates softening supply-side conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and compressing valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in softening supply periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 consecutive months suggests the Federal Reserve is committed to disinflation, lowering real discount rates and boosting equity present value, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, raising consumer and business confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tight labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
